Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Graphic Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Blue / Red
Colors: Blue/Red
Made in the United States and imported The 3-tone geometric pattern on this modern throw pillow is as bold as it is beautiful, making a contemporary statement with style. A solid cream back adds high contrast and drama. 17"L x 17"W Modern geometric pattern brings attitude to your decor. Back of pillow is solid cream-colored fabric. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow insert arrives in vacuum sealed bag. Carefully remove insert from packaging and let it fully expand before putting inside of pillow cover.
